values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Publication linkage, exact-head identity, closing relationships, artifact denominator, redaction, and digest checks
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until this child is bound, every declared predecessor passes, and the issue-owned validator is implemented; missing target, zero denominator, or failure blocks publication.

lanes.proof_role: Reject malformed tracked changes before exact-head review.
lanes.defer_reason: Run after the issue has a bounded candidate diff.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on dependency, ownership, authority, privacy, validation, exact-revision, or review drift; preserve evidence and route separate defects without widening this issue.
